No slides, no pitch. We listen first, ask the questions most consultancies don’t, and come back with a proposal you can use — or an honest no.

Preferred contact method

What happens next

  1. Within a day. We come back with a short reply — a few questions, or a time to talk.
  2. A 30-minute call. We listen. No slides, no pitch. Most calls end with us telling you what we’d do, not selling you on it.
  3. A proposal. Built around your team, your situation, your budget. Often a single page.

In a hurry?

If your training is in the next two weeks, mention it in the message. We keep capacity for short-notice work where we can.
